basis: Legacy mappings preserved from scripts/l1_annotate_templates.py. Directory names are not record labels. MATH_PHYS to SCI_TECH is lossy; use canonical labels for explicit scope.

unresolved_namespaces.ART_SPORT: Use canonical ARTS_SPORTS explicitly; old fallback to GLOBAL is not a trustworthy equivalence.
unresolved_namespaces.planning_layer: Six planning clusters do not have a verified one-to-one correspondence with five corpus labels; caller must choose corpus scope explicitly.

global_policy: GLOBAL is explicit cross-cluster browsing over recognized labels, including generic GLOBAL records. Unknown and dirty labels are excluded, not deleted.
semantic_status: Existing labels may be wrong. Label consistency is not validated disciplinary relevance.
